info.title: Schedules
info.description: API endpoints used to manage Schedules in WinTeam.

get.description: This API endpoint will return Employees' shift detail information with the ability to filter the results based on employee number and date range. If EmployeeNumber is used as a Filter then pagination is not necessary. In situations where EmployeeNumber is not provided, all Employee Shift Details will be returned. This could return a large result set. Filtering and Paging is always recommended when no Employee Number is provided.

parameters.name: employeeNumber
parameters.description: Format - int32. If there is an employee number, filter results for that employee, else retrieve all employees

parameters.name: fromDate
parameters.description: Format - date-time (as date-time in RFC3339). Date from when the user wants to filter the results

parameters.name: toDate
parameters.description: Format - date-time (as date-time in RFC3339). If there are From and To date, filter results based on those inputs, else return information from Today and Tomorrow

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Format - int32. The size of the page.

parameters.name: pageNumber
parameters.description: Format - int32. The page number you want to retrieve.

parameters.name: orderBy
parameters.description: Format - int32. A datapoint you’d like to sort records by. Possible values are: "EmployeeNumber", "JobNumber", "WorkDate", "JobDescription", "PostID", "PostDescription", "PostDetailID", "TimeZoneName", "ShiftID", "ScheduleDetailID", "StartTime", "EndTime", "Lunch", "Hours", "CategoriesDetailID", "HourType"

parameters.name: ascending
parameters.description: Indicates whether or not the order should be ascending (true) or descending (false)

parameters.name: tenantId
parameters.description: We'll provide a description of what this value represents and how to obtain one.

example.serverResponse: Operation failed! See the Errors for more information.
Operation failed! See the Errors for more information.

get.description: Employee Recent Schedules endpoint returns by default, the last three shifts for an employee looking back seven days. Updating the offset will allow you to reach back N of shifts in the previous seven days. This endpoint includes an option to stack shifts, summarizing shift punch in/out and punch source across posts. Punch Source options are PSTT, PSTT reconcile, and Team Time. If IsStackedShifts is  true, we'll combine contiguous shifts based on work date and job number.

parameters.name: employeeKey
parameters.description: Employee number or Employee Id.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Format - int32. The number of shifts before the current day to return. The default value is -3.

parameters.name: includePSTT
parameters.description: If true, it will include PSTT records on the result, by default False.

parameters.name: isStackedShifts
parameters.description: If true, it will combine the contiguous shift and create stacked shifts for them, by default False.

parameters.name: onlyETK
parameters.description: If true, it will only return schedules for jobs that are setup for TeamTime, by default False.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Format - int32. The size of the page.

parameters.name: pageNumber
parameters.description: Format - int32. The page number you want to retrieve.

parameters.name: searchFieldName
parameters.description: A datapoint you’d like to search records by. Possible values are: "JobNumber", "JobState", "ScheduleInTime", "ScheduleOutTime", "Lunch", "Hours", "PunchInSource", "PunchOutSource", "PostDetailId", "JobPostId"

parameters.name: searchText
parameters.description: The text you’ll search for in results from the "SearchFieldName" you’ve specified.

parameters.name: orderBy
parameters.description: A datapoint you’d like to sort records by. Possible values are: "JobNumber", "JobState", "ScheduleInTime", "ScheduleOutTime", "Lunch", "Hours", "PunchInSource", "PunchOutSource", "PostDetailId", "JobPostId"

parameters.name: ascending
parameters.description: Indicates whether or not the order should be ascending (true) or descending (false)
